_meta.title: Who holds the federal debt
_meta.source: US Treasury Debt to the Penny (public vs intragovernmental, 7 Aug 2026); Treasury International Capital (foreign holdings, 2025)
notes: Foreign holders are about 30% of PUBLICLY HELD debt, which is about 24% of GROSS debt. Do not conflate. Al Jazeera reported 32% of gross; that figure does not reconcile.
TIC data is revised monthly. China has been reported between $683B and $760B depending on vintage.
Federal Reserve holdings are reported between $4.53T and $4.9T across sources; omitted rather than pick one.

refresh.reason: source publishes as a document, not a machine-readable feed

deliberate_omissions.federal_reserve_holdings: OMIT rather than pick. This is a deliberate absence, not missing data. If a future fetcher starts supplying a Fed holdings figure, it must not be charted without re-opening this decision.
